udt_struct_v0.doc:
Core data structure for a Flow (open-ended, rate-per-second) stream.

Ported from Sablier's `Flow.Stream` struct with these adaptations:

- `UD21x18 ratePerSecond` \xe2\x86\x92 `i128 rate_per_second` scaled to 18 decimals.
Soroban has no native fixed-point type, so we use i128 with manual scaling.
A rate of 1 token/sec for a 7-decimal token = 1e18 internally.

- `IERC20 token` \xe2\x86\x92 `Address` (Soroban token contract address).

- `uint128 balance` \xe2\x86\x92 `i128` (Soroban SDK convention for token amounts).

- `uint40 snapshotTime` \xe2\x86\x92 `u64` (Soroban ledger timestamp is u64).

- `bool isStream` sentinel removed \xe2\x80\x94 we use storage key existence instead.

- `bool isTransferable` removed \xe2\x80\x94 delegated to the NFT contract layer.

# Storage Layout

Each stream is stored under `DataKey::Stream(stream_id)` in persistent storage.
The struct is kept as flat as possible to minimize serialization overhead.
udt_struct_v0.name: FlowStream

fields.doc: Current balance held in the stream (deposited - withdrawn), in token decimals.
fields.name: balance

fields.doc: Whether the stream has been permanently voided.
fields.name: is_voided

fields.doc: Rate at which debt accrues, in 18-decimal fixed-point.\n0 means the stream is paused.\nExample: 1 token/sec for a 7-decimal token \xe2\x86\x92 1_000_000_000_000_000_000 (1e18).
fields.name: rate_per_second

fields.doc: The address receiving the tokens (can withdraw).
fields.name: recipient

fields.doc: The address streaming the tokens (can pause, adjust, refund).
fields.name: sender

fields.doc: Accumulated debt at the last snapshot, in 18-decimal fixed-point.\nTotal debt = snapshot_debt_scaled + ongoing_debt_scaled.
fields.name: snapshot_debt_scaled

fields.doc: Unix timestamp of the last debt snapshot.\nDebt accrues from this point forward at `rate_per_second`.
fields.name: snapshot_time

fields.doc: The Soroban token contract address (SAC or custom SEP-41).
fields.name: token

fields.doc: Number of decimals for the token (e.g. 7 for most Stellar assets).\nUsed for scale/descale operations. Max 18.
fields.name: token_decimals

udt_enum_v0.name: StreamType

udt_enum_v0.doc:
Status of a Lockup stream.

Uses "temperature" semantics:
- **Warm** (Pending, Streaming): time alone can change the status.
- **Cold** (Settled, Canceled, Depleted): time alone cannot change the status.
udt_enum_v0.name: LockupStatus

cases.doc: Created but start_time is in the future. No tokens have vested.
cases.name: Pending

cases.doc: Active \xe2\x80\x94 tokens are currently vesting over time.
cases.name: Streaming

cases.doc: All tokens have fully vested. Recipient can withdraw the remaining balance.
cases.name: Settled

cases.doc: Sender canceled the stream. Unvested tokens returned to sender.
cases.name: Canceled

cases.doc: Fully withdrawn (and/or refunded). No tokens remain in the stream.
cases.name: Depleted

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Core data structure for a Lockup (fixed-term vesting) stream.

Supports linear unlock with optional cliff. The vested ("streamed") amount
at any time `t` is calculated as:

```text
if t < start_time:       vested = 0
if t < cliff_time:       vested = start_unlock_amount
if t >= end_time:         vested = total_amount
else:
elapsed = floor((t - cliff_time) / granularity) * granularity
streamable_duration = end_time - cliff_time
streamable_amount = total_amount - start_unlock_amount - cliff_unlock_amount
vested = start_unlock_amount + cliff_unlock_amount + (elapsed * streamable_amount / streamable_duration)
```

This mirrors the reference linear lockup calculation with discrete unlock
steps at `granularity`-second intervals.
udt_struct_v0.name: LockupStream

fields.doc: Whether the sender can cancel this stream and reclaim unvested tokens.
fields.name: cancelable

fields.doc: Optional cliff timestamp. No tokens beyond `start_unlock_amount`\nvest before this time. Set to 0 for no cliff.
fields.name: cliff_time

fields.doc: Amount unlocked at `cliff_time` (in addition to `start_unlock_amount`).
fields.name: cliff_unlock_amount

fields.doc: Unix timestamp when the lockup is fully unlocked.
fields.name: end_time

fields.doc: Unlock granularity in seconds. Tokens vest in discrete steps of this\ninterval. Default = 1 (per-second vesting). Must be > 0.
fields.name: granularity

fields.doc: Whether all tokens have been withdrawn and/or refunded.
fields.name: is_depleted

fields.doc: The address that receives tokens as they unlock (can withdraw).
fields.name: recipient

fields.doc: Amount refunded to sender on cancellation. Zero unless cancelled.
fields.name: refunded_amount

fields.doc: The address that created and funded the lockup (can cancel if `cancelable`).
fields.name: sender

fields.doc: Unix timestamp when the lockup begins.
fields.name: start_time

fields.doc: Amount unlocked immediately at `start_time`.
fields.name: start_unlock_amount

fields.doc: The Soroban token contract address.
fields.name: token

fields.doc: Total amount deposited into the stream (in token decimals).
fields.name: total_amount

fields.doc: Whether the stream has been cancelled.
fields.name: was_canceled

fields.doc: Cumulative amount withdrawn by the recipient.
fields.name: withdrawn_amount

udt_enum_v0.doc:
Status of a Flow stream.

The status is derived from the stream's current state (rate, balance, debt, voided flag) rather than
being stored directly \xe2\x80\x94 keeping storage minimal.
udt_enum_v0.name: StreamStatus

cases.doc: Stream scheduled to start in the future (snapshot_time > now).
cases.name: Pending

cases.doc: Actively streaming with balance covering all debt.
cases.name: StreamingSolvent

cases.doc: Actively streaming but debt exceeds available balance.
cases.name: StreamingInsolvent

cases.doc: Paused by sender with no uncovered debt.
cases.name: PausedSolvent

cases.doc: Paused by sender with uncovered debt.
cases.name: PausedInsolvent

cases.doc: Permanently stopped. Cannot be restarted. Uncovered debt written off.
cases.name: Voided
